app.name: Screen Recording and Video Calls by Screendesk
app.short_description: Screen and camera recordings, video calls and AI resolution in every ticket.
app.long_description:
Let customers show you the issue instead of describing it. Screendesk puts screen recordings, video calls, booking links and AI resolution in every Zendesk ticket. Trusted by 1,000+ customer-facing teams, and SOC 2 Type II compliant.

### SEE THE ISSUE

* **Request a recording in one click**  
From the ticket sidebar or the reply toolbar. On a computer, your customer records their screen. On a phone, they film the product or the issue with the camera, front or back. No download, no account.

* **Console logs, network requests and device details**  
On your own website (with the Screendesk snippet), recordings come with the console, network activity, browser and device. Choose which website the customer records on.

* **Sensitive data blurred automatically**  
Auto blur hides sensitive data in recordings before anyone sees them.

* **Recordings land in the ticket**  
Each recording is added as an internal note with the video and its full report, and the ticket reopens. Every recording from that customer is listed in the sidebar.

* **Send a video back**  
Record a response to show the customer what to do, or insert a saved video from your library.

### TALK IT THROUGH LIVE

* **Video calls with screen sharing**  
Start a call from the ticket and the link goes in your reply. Everyone joins from the browser. Record the call if you want to keep it.

* **Booking links**  
Let the customer pick a time from your team's calendars, for a video call in a Screendesk room. The booking is added to the ticket.

### RESOLVE FASTER WITH AI

* **AI resolution**  
Screendesk reviews the ticket and the recording, then suggests the likely cause and a reply you can insert, with the evidence behind it. Available on plans with AI resolution.

* **AI summaries and transcripts**  
Know what a recording shows before you press play.

### BUILT FOR ZENDESK

* Works in the ticket sidebar and the reply toolbar, in light and dark mode
* Tags for Zendesk Explore: screendesk-recording-requested, screendesk-recording-received, screendesk-recording-sent, screendesk-video-shared, screendesk-live-screensharing
* Help Center and ticket forms: customers can attach a recording when they submit a request

### SECURITY AND COMPLIANCE

* SOC 2 Type II
* GDPR and CCPA compliant
* SAML SSO
* Restricted recording access
* Automatic data deletion
* Sensitive data masking

Questions? Visit our [help center](https://docs.screendesk.io) or email support@screendesk.io.
app.installation_instructions:
1. Click **Install**.
2. Open any ticket and find **Screendesk** in the apps panel on the right. Pin it so it's always one click away.
3. Click **Connect workspace**. In the new tab, sign in to Screendesk or create an account with the same email you use in Zendesk, then allow access. A Screendesk admin only does this once, for the whole team.
4. Come back to Zendesk: the panel opens Screendesk by itself.
5. Invite your agents to your Screendesk workspace with the email they use in Zendesk.

Need help? Read the [setup guide](https://docs.screendesk.io/integrations/zendesk/install-and-set-up) or email support@screendesk.io.
